rawContent: This is your occasional reminder that NBC is owned by Comcast, which stands to profit massively from the repeal of #NetNeutrality They also employed Matt Lauer, of #MeToo fame, and had him interview Trump and HRC, who he treated very unequally. @nbc is 💯% not an honest broker.

Instead, we shake our heads sadly or in anger when we read about #metoo situations, but never ask the question, "Who were their bosses and why was this OK with them?" Even Les Moonves answered to a board of directors, and presumably someone at Viacom, which owns CBS.

The reason that #metoo matters is that it exposes INSTITUTIONAL VALUES. The question isn't how someone got away with it, but who knew what and when. This is the world we live in. Corporate structures are little dictatorships, and no one is ever allowed to question that structure.

@Mike_Eagle Yeah I believe it. From everything I know, most of the powerful producers, agents, directors, etc, the entire who's who of Hollywood, are #MeToo cases waiting to be aired. We can't let them turn the page on this.
